newsitem.title: GREECE: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS- JUNE 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - GREEK GENERAL NEWS- JUNE 30.

text.p: Leading stories in the Greek general press:

--The Albanian Socialist Party appears to have had a massive win in yesterday's national poll, wiping out President Sali Berisha and the ruling Democratic Party. Socialist leader Fatos Nano says he hopes Berisha keeps his word and resigns.
--European Union socialist finance ministers meeting in Athens over the weekend have developed a charter on minimal rights for workers and the unemployed.
--Jacques Delors, the former European Commission president, says that socialists have to match their values with the fiscal crisis facing the welfare state.

--National Economy and Finance Minister Yannos Papandoniou is concerned that the economy and economic policies will become the focus of party games - both with opposition parties and within ruling PASOK.

--Anthony Quinn, the Hollywood actor who immortalised Nikos Kazantzakis's hedonistic Alexis Zorba in "Zorba the Greek", says he is not averse to playing late PASOK president and founder Andreas Papandreou.
--An increase in the tax scale will mean extra taxes in the order of 150,000 drachmas for those earning over four million drachmas a year.

--Culture Minister Evangelos Venizelos says there may be differences of opinion between deputies of ruling party PASOK but that nobody is undermining or doubting the implementation of the government's policies. --Maria Petrakis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
